verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents agent connectivity: an official MCP server for AI clients, a REST API and webhooks. These are building blocks an agent could use to read data. Nothing in the pack shows ledger monitoring, spend-anomaly flagging, or duplicate-transaction detection. The only duplicate-detection evidence covers contacts, not transactions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
